confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, with no web search used for city prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and carry July high-season uncertainty. The FX rate came from a search summary of the RBA exchange rates page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Brazilian restaurant and lodging price levels, with a tourism premium for a nature-tourism hub during the July winter school-holiday peak. Loosely comparable to Bonito (MS) and similar Brazilian waterfall and nature destinations.
